description: This is a PHP class file defining the SugarWebServiceUtilv3_1 class, which extends SugarWebServiceUtilv3. It contains utility methods for handling web service interactions in SuiteCRM, including functions for retrieving module fields, tracking views, managing modules, generating search fields, ACL checks, and file content handling.

classes.name: SugarWebServiceUtilv3_1
classes.description: A utility class extending SugarWebServiceUtilv3, providing methods for web service interactions such as module field retrieval, view tracking, module listing, unified search field generation, ACL checks, and file content encoding.

methods.name: get_return_module_fields
methods.description: Retrieves module-specific fields and link fields from a given object, returning formatted module information including table name.

methods.name: trackView
methods.description: Tracks a user's view action for a specific bean and view type, updating the tracker monitor with user, module, and item details.

methods.name: getModulesFromList
methods.description: Converts a list of modules into a format suitable for web service responses, considering user ACL permissions.

methods.name: get_visible_modules
methods.description: Fetches the list of modules visible/enabled for the current user session by invoking the TabController.

methods.name: generateUnifiedSearchFields
methods.description: Generates a list of searchable fields for a specified module, inspecting vardefs and metadata.

methods.name: checkModuleRoleAccess
methods.description: Checks specified permissions (edit, delete, list, view, import, export) for a given module, returning access results.

methods.name: get_field_list
methods.description: Extracts and returns module and link field definitions for a given object, including label translations and relation info.

methods.name: get_file_contents_base64
methods.description: Reads file contents and returns them base64 encoded; optionally deletes the file afterward.

methods.name: get_module_view_defs
methods.description: Retrieves view definitions for a specified module and view type, including list and subpanel views.

methods.name: get_data_list
methods.description: Fetches a list of module records with optional filters, order, and pagination, supporting favorites filtering.

methods.name: addFieldLevelACLs
methods.description: Adds ACL-related restrictions or data to view metadata by invoking specific ACL parser methods.

methods.name: getFieldLevelACLValue
methods.description: Returns raw ACL permission value for a specific user, module, and field, defaulting to maximum if user is admin.
